newsitem.title: USA: IMM currencies remain higher on U.S. confidence.
newsitem.headline: IMM currencies remain higher on U.S. confidence.

text.p: April 29 - IMM currency futures remained higher across the board after U.S. consumer confidence data. April confidence fell to 116.8, vs estimates of 118.4 and against March's 118.5. Expectations fell 101.4, from a revised 101.1 in March. Traders said pit trade was light and thin. ((Chicago Derivatives Desk (312)408-8750/))
